"Main failure accept karta—sab kisi na kisi pe fail hote."
Jeevan mein aapko kayi haar ka samna karna padega, lekin khud ko kabhi haarne mat dena.
Control haath mein lo.
Success ke baad failure ka intezar mat karo.
Jo ek ghanta waste karta hai, usne life ki value nahi samjhi.
Mind ko upar wali cheezon pe lagao.
Confidence woh feeling hai jo action tak le jati.
Samajhdaar bano.
Mushkile hi zindagi ko dilchasp banati hain, aur unhe jeetna zindagi ko matlab deta hai.
Attitude height decide karta hai.
